_help.api_key: Leave this empty if the local server does not require an API key.
_help.wake_word: The wake-word model stored in the models directory. Available models include hey_jarvis, alexa, hey_mycroft, hey_rhasspy, timer, and weather.
_help.device: The input device name or index shown by: python3 voice_client.py --list-devices. On this computer, use 15 for PipeWire with the default BY Y01 microphone. The index may change after a restart.
_help.threshold: Wake-word detection sensitivity from 0.0 to 1.0. Lower values trigger more easily but may cause false detections; higher values reduce false detections but may be harder to trigger. Start with 0.5.
_help.timeout: Maximum number of seconds to wait for the server to respond to each request. A value of 180 means three minutes.
